text: In a pnpm/yarn workspace monorepo a changed file only reaches the related-test lookup of its own package (test-scope.mjs select: sel.related[p.pkg.name]); tests of workspace DEPENDENTS (workspace: deps) are never selected. When dependents import the upstream through package.json exports -> dist/, even the runner's module graph stops at dist, and selected dependent tests would run against a stale build. Found on a real monorepo where `pnpm --filter "...[base]"` after `pnpm build` was safer than test-scope. Needs: resolve related tests in each workspace dependent against its view of the changed file (src, or a dist->src map from the exports), a per-package prebuild of changed upstream packages before dependents run, and a doctor warning when exports point at dist with no source alias.

Parts match changed PATHS only, so a part cannot express 'any migration touching table X' — a new migration file name (0036_*.sql) does not name the table. Proposal: optional `diffMatch` regex on a part evaluated over the diff's added lines, with `paths` as the prefilter (e.g. paths server/migrations/**, diffMatch ALTER TABLE\s+agents\b).

`run` executes a part's `checks` after its tests, so a step that must precede tests (build changed upstream packages) cannot be expressed as a check; needs an ordered pre-step (e.g. `prebuild`) distinct from post-test checks.
`measure` always writes .test-scope/metrics.jsonl even when --config points to a config elsewhere; the metrics file should live next to the chosen config (or be settable).
